maya (Support): Customer reports intermittent 403 'Billing required' when clicking Generate in the UI. Can we get a HAR + console dump + cURL so we can find the x-request-id and trace it?

maya (Support): Quick checklist I usually ask customers for: browser + version, OS, a timestamp of the failure, whether incognito reproduces, network (home/corp/VPN), and a screenshot of the billing modal if shown.

jon (SRE): Pls also include the exact x-request-id header value from the failing request (or the request shown in the HAR). That lets me pull backend logs quickly.

maya (Support): Steps to capture (Chrome / Edge):
1. Open browser, reproduce the bug.
2. F12 -> Network tab. Check 'Preserve log' and set 'All' or filter for 'api.redwood' (or 'api.redwood.cloud').
3. Click the Generate/submit button to reproduce.
4. Right-click the failed request -> Copy -> 'Copy as cURL (bash)'. Paste into the ticket and replace the Authorization token with '<REDACTED>'.
5. Right-click anywhere in Network -> 'Save all as HAR with content' -> attach .har to ticket.
6. Console tab: open Console, reproduce, right-click console -> 'Save as...' (or copy relevant lines). If console messages are noisy, take a screenshot and include the time near the error.

maya (Support): Example curl (please redact token before sending):
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.cloud/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REPLACE_ME' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary '{"input":"test prompt"}' \
  --compressed
```

maya (Support): If using Firefox: DevTools -> Network -> right-click request -> 'Save All As HAR'. Console -> right-click -> 'Export Visible Messages' (or copy + paste).

alex (Platform): Important: ask them to include the timestamp (UTC) of the attempt and the account/org id (do NOT include full API keys). Also ask if they're using any client-side proxy or VPN.

maya (Support): Upload guidance: attach HAR + curl + console screenshot to the ticket, or use our internal upload link (https://files.redwood.ai/support-upload) and paste the resulting link into the ticket. Mark files 'private'.

maya (Support): Short troubleshooting tips for the customer (safe to try before sending):
- Try Incognito to rule out extensions.
- Clear cache / hard reload.
- Try from a different network (phone hotspot) to rule out corp firewall.
- If they see the billing modal, note the exact copy/screenshots and the time.

jon (SRE): When you paste the HAR, call out the failed request and include the 'x-request-id' and response body (if present). If the HAR is too big, they can right-click the single request -> 'Save as HAR' to keep it small.

maya (Support): Privacy note -> Please redact Authorization headers and any user PII before attaching. If they accidentally include tokens, ask them to rotate keys and tell us in the ticket.

dev-support-bot: Automated reminder: attach at least one HAR + one cURL + console screenshot per our support SLA for UI network issues.

maya (Support): Thanks — once we have the HAR + curl + x-request-id I'll ping SRE to trace the backend span. :thumbsup:

jon (SRE): Got it — I'll look once the HAR is in. If you can provide an example failing cURL I can replay it from infra and collect the server trace (please include timestamp).

maya (Support): I'll follow up with the customer and paste the upload link here.

maya (Support): (follow-up after upload) Customer uploaded har: https://files.redwood.ai/s/abc123 (redacted). x-request-id: 01H8K2YQ9Z2P1A0XJKL4M5N6. Repro time: 2026-03-16T18:12:07Z. Browser: Chrome 111.0.0, macOS 13.4.

jon (SRE): Thanks — pulling logs now.

maya (Support): closing loop — will update ticket with next steps and any account-level billing flags.
